name: claude-code-mods
description: Eight open-source Claude Code mods by rzem-ai: live agent maps, context and cache bands, panes and alerts

plugins.name: agent-narrator
plugins.description: Watch the agent work: every step in plain English, with a live time-saved counter

plugins.name: agent-race
plugins.description: Race Claude Code sessions on a task: live split-screen race track scoreboard

plugins.name: agent-tree
plugins.description: Live pane with the tree of the orchestrator and its subagents: model, effort, tokens, tools and duration

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Your context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, a color per category, with token counts and the compaction point

plugins.name: inbox-alerts
plugins.description: Gmail, Slack and Calendar alerts inside Claude Code: toasts, a status count, and an Alerts pane

plugins.name: mission-control
plugins.description: Live map of the main agent, its subagents and every tool call, plus a code map of the files they touch

plugins.name: swarm
plugins.description: Mission control for subagents and agent teams: who is running, what each is doing, who spawned whom, who is talking to whom, and how they overlap

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A live forecast of the context window above the prompt, with a prompt-cache countdown
